name: Service That Sells — Maharlika Bank's Service-Brand Recovery
description: A four-round, intermediate marketing and services-management simulation set inside Maharlika Bank, a PHP 38-billion universal retail bank in Makati, Metro Manila, serving 3.4 million customers through 280 branches and 9,200 employees (5,600 customer-facing). The Q1 2026 tracker has just printed the bank's first customer-satisfaction decline in eight years — top-2-box satisfaction down from 78% to 69%, the brand-equity index from 64 to 58, and the SERVQUAL service-quality gap widened to 1.8 points, its worst ever. The board sets a binding recovery target: return satisfaction to 75% within four quarters, with a fixed PHP 600M marketing-and-service budget — or it cuts the budget and pivots to pure price competition. Below 65%, that pivot is automatic. Playing the new CMO, you work the full internal-marketing-orientation chain (Kang's research, AIM): internal service quality → front-line engagement → customer satisfaction → brand equity → marketing ROI. Round 1: diagnose the gap — decompose it by SERVQUAL dimension, decide whether it originates at the customer interface or upstream in internal service (tellers wait 4.2 days for IT and 6 days for credit against a 1-day standard), and separate the symptom (low satisfaction) from the cause (internal service failure). Round 2: build internal marketing orientation — set a resourced internal SLA, grant capped front-line empowerment for service recovery, and make internal departments want to serve their colleagues through recognition and shared scorecards, not just a mandate. Round 3: allocate the full PHP 600M across external advertising, customer-facing service investment and internal marketing, and re-set the advertised service promise (branches run 34 minutes; you can credibly reach 22). Round 4: defend the plan to the board and absorb a live shock — a viral complaint, a neobank ad blitz, or a CFO budget cut — without abandoning the service-led strategy, and name the one leading indicator you will watch. The math wires the concept's common errors so every wrong strategy measurably underperforms: 'advertising the fix' (a big campaign amplifying an undeliverable promise), treating low satisfaction as a front-line training problem, mandating SLAs with no resourcing, defending an undeliverable 15-minute promise, and ignoring the service-profit-chain lag. Over-promising and advertising-the-fix set sticky run-defining flags that cap satisfaction below the 75% target, so a blind click-through of the seeded defaults cannot win. Final KPIs track customer satisfaction (%), the service-quality gap (SERVQUAL points), the brand-equity index and marketing ROI.

10 March 2026 · Maharlika Bank · Makati · 90 days to prove the service brand

Service That Sells

You are the new CMO of Maharlika Bank. Satisfaction has fallen from 78% to 69% and the service-quality gap is the widest on record (1.8 pts). The board wants 75% within four quarters; below 65% it cuts the budget and competes on price. You hold ₱600M and four quarters to decide what the bank promises, what it changes inside, and how the money is divided.

Round 1 — Diagnose the service-quality gap

Your Decisions This Round

Effort spent quantifying attrition & ₱410M-per-point stakes: 30%
Current trajectory loses ~190,000 customers a year. Each point of annual attrition ≈ ₱410M in lost lifetime revenue.
Counts against the ₱600M: up to ₱300M this round; you can add a top-up in Round 3.
The three slices plus your Round 2 internal commitment must fit inside ₱600M.
Facilitator (the board & the voice of 3.4M customers)
The tracker has printed the first satisfaction decline in eight years. Four explanations are circulating, each with a sponsor: the branch managers say the counter experience has slipped; the operations diagnostic points to the turnaround times internal departments give the front line; the agency says ₱220M a year no longer buys share of voice; customer insight says digital entrants have raised what customers expect. The board meets in eleven days.

Round-by-Round Record

Satisfaction, Brand Equity & Service-Quality Gap

text.en: Diagnose a customer-satisfaction decline to its origin, distinguishing the measured symptom from its cause in the internal service chain
text.es: Diagnosticar el origen de una caída de la satisfacción del cliente, distinguiendo el síntoma medido de su causa en la cadena de servicio interna

text.en: Set an advertised service standard the operation can deliver and evaluate what an undeliverable promise does to satisfaction and brand equity
text.es: Fijar un estándar de servicio anunciado que la operación pueda cumplir y evaluar lo que una promesa incumplible provoca en la satisfacción y el valor de marca

text.en: Allocate a fixed budget across advertising, customer-facing service and internal service repair in line with the diagnosed binding constraint
text.es: Repartir un presupuesto fijo entre publicidad, servicio de cara al cliente y reparación del servicio interno de acuerdo con la restricción crítica diagnosticada

text.en: Design internal service commitments that are resourced and reinforced rather than mandated, and calibrate front-line resolution authority against its cost
text.es: Diseñar compromisos de servicio interno dotados de recursos y reforzados en lugar de impuestos, y calibrar la autoridad de resolución de primera línea frente a su coste

text.en: Manage stakeholders through the lag between an internal intervention and its effect on customer metrics, and select a leading indicator that moves first
text.es: Gestionar a los grupos de interés durante el desfase entre una intervención interna y su efecto en los indicadores de cliente, y elegir un indicador adelantado que se mueva antes

name.en: Locating the failure at the counter
name.es: Situar el fallo en la ventanilla

lure.en: Satisfaction is measured where the customer meets the teller, and a 34-minute wait is felt at the counter, so faster, warmer front-line staff look like the direct fix
lure.es: La satisfacción se mide donde el cliente encuentra al cajero y la espera de 34 minutos se vive en la ventanilla, así que un personal de primera línea más rápido y cálido parece el arreglo directo

consequence.en: The spend chases the symptom; the misdiagnosis caps satisfaction below the 75% target for the rest of the run, however well the later rounds are played
consequence.es: El gasto persigue el síntoma; el mal diagnóstico limita la satisfacción por debajo del objetivo del 75% durante el resto de la partida, por bien que se jueguen las rondas siguientes

source.ref: TN §13 The interface reflex (R1); Q1 likely positions

name.en: Mandating the one-day standard without capacity
name.es: Imponer el estándar de un día sin capacidad

lure.en: The one-day standard is already on the books and looks more ambitious than a resourced two-day standard; a memo costs nothing
lure.es: El estándar de un día ya existe y parece más ambicioso que uno de dos días con recursos; una instrucción no cuesta nada

consequence.en: Engagement falls, the gap widens and the queued improvement is small; IT and credit treat the standard as one more number to miss (TN run F, Brand at Risk)
consequence.es: El compromiso cae, la brecha se amplía y la mejora en cola es pequeña; TI y crédito tratan el estándar como un número más que incumplir (TN, partida F, Marca en Riesgo)

source.ref: TN §13 Ambition mistaken for rigour (R2); Q4; TN-Exhibit 7 run F

lure.en: Dropping the advertised standard feels like a public admission of weakness while the neobanks advertise speed
lure.es: Bajar el estándar anunciado se siente como admitir debilidad en público mientras los neobancos anuncian rapidez

consequence.en: The promise cannot be kept on any path; satisfaction and brand equity fall, and the over-promise caps satisfaction below the target for the rest of the run (TN run G)
consequence.es: La promesa no se puede cumplir por ningún camino; caen la satisfacción y el valor de marca, y la sobrepromesa limita la satisfacción por debajo del objetivo el resto de la partida (TN, partida G)

source.ref: TN §13 Loyalty to the advertised number (R3); Q2; TN-Exhibits 5 and 7 run G

name.en: Funding the campaign before the internal repair
name.es: Financiar la campaña antes que la reparación interna

lure.en: The advertising slice is the one marketing fully owns, and share of voice against louder neobanks feels urgent
lure.es: La partida de publicidad es la única que marketing controla del todo, y la cuota de voz frente a neobancos más ruidosos parece urgente

consequence.en: With internal repair under PHP 100M the largest campaign amplifies the gap: satisfaction is capped below target and the run is graded Advertised the Fix (TN run D)
consequence.es: Con la reparación interna por debajo de PHP 100M la campaña más grande amplifica la brecha: la satisfacción queda limitada bajo el objetivo y la partida se califica Anunciar el Arreglo (TN, partida D)

source.ref: TN §13 Allocating by ownership (R3); Q3; TN-Exhibit 7 run D

name.en: Promising the board the target next quarter
name.es: Prometer al consejo el objetivo para el próximo trimestre

lure.en: A promise that 75% arrives next quarter calms this board meeting, and the quarterly satisfaction score is the number the board asks about
lure.es: Prometer que el 75% llega el próximo trimestre calma esta reunión del consejo, y el índice trimestral de satisfacción es el número por el que pregunta el consejo

consequence.en: It trades this meeting's comfort for the next meeting's credibility and leaves no leading indicator to manage the lag with; brand equity falls
consequence.es: Cambia la calma de esta reunión por la credibilidad de la siguiente y deja sin indicador adelantado con el que gestionar el desfase; cae el valor de marca

source.ref: TN §13 Reading the lag as failure (R2 to R3) and instructor trap 4; Q5 likely positions
